name: Filmora
tagline: AI-powered video editing software for desktop and mobile, aimed at beginners and creators.
about: Wondershare Filmora is a timeline video editor with effects, templates and AI tools for captions, cut-outs and audio clean-up.
pros: Easy timeline editor with many effects and templates.
AI tools for captions, cut-outs and audio clean-up.
cons: The free version exports with a watermark.
Some AI features use paid credits.
